ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 white-to-black pixel ratio on the visible ventral surface, characterized by high-intensity white lobes and low-intensity black margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions across both lobes; thick, continuous black pigmented band along the entire trailing edge; central black wedge-shaped zone extending from the notch; scattered discrete black focal spots and fine striations on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular profile featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (1-5 pixel depth) across both lobes, appearing more jagged towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve profile; proximal regions near the notch exhibit slight concavity, transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular 3D structures (acorn barnacles) localized heavily at the distal tips of both fluke lobes; secondary clusters visible along the inferior trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower quadrant of the left lobe; smaller vertical linear scars near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; multiple sets of parallel rake marks indicating previous interspecific interactions; visible indentation on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'X' shaped dark pigment/scarring cluster on the lower-left fluke lobe near the peduncle junction.
